annotation.static_scene: A narrow enclosed ancient stone corridor with cobblestone floors, rough-hewn stone walls, and wall-mounted torches casting warm light. Scattered rubble litters the floor.
annotation.subject_motion: The robed character walks through a stone corridor and climbs a central staircase toward an upper level.
annotation.environment_motion: A cow-like creature stands idle near the wall to the left.
annotation.camera_description: A stabilized third-person chest-height perspective follows the character, moving forward and then ascending.

annotation.static_scene: A narrow enclosed sidewalk beside a multi-story concrete parking garage with red trim and a tall cinder block retaining wall. A red and white lattice communication tower is visible in the distance.
annotation.subject_motion: The character walks steadily forward along a narrow sidewalk and turns right to follow the path of a concrete wall.
annotation.environment_motion: An advertising blimp floats in the distant orange sky while the rest of the scene remains still with only parked vehicles.
annotation.camera_description: A stabilized third-person perspective at chest height following the subject from behind, moving forward and then turning right.

annotation.static_scene: A narrow enclosed alley with asphalt ground and weathered gray concrete buildings featuring industrial pipes, AC units, and red-and-white striped concrete barriers.
annotation.subject_motion: The player moves slowly forward through a narrow alley, observing a burning garbage pile on the right.
annotation.environment_motion: A large pile of garbage bags is engulfed in active flames, emitting smoke and embers.
annotation.camera_description: The camera is in a first-person perspective at eye level, moving forward with a stabilized walking motion.

annotation.static_scene: A narrow cabin entryway corridor with rough wooden walls, a wooden deck floor, and structural support beams.
annotation.subject_motion: The character in period clothing opens the cabin door and walks forward through a narrow wooden corridor.
annotation.environment_motion: The scene is static as the character moves from the exterior into the enclosed entryway.
annotation.camera_description: A stabilized third-person perspective at chest height following the character from behind with a smooth walking motion.

annotation.static_scene: A wide-open flooded ruin area with crumbling stone walls on both sides and a large castle visible in the far distance under a blue hour sky.
annotation.subject_motion: The character in ornate armor with red hair wades forward through shallow water.
annotation.environment_motion: Mist swirls around the ruins while red particles drift in the air.
annotation.camera_description: A stabilized third-person follow camera at chest height, moving forward in a straight line.

annotation.static_scene: A wide-open rural highway with an asphalt surface, sparse vegetation, and distant hills under direct natural lighting.
annotation.subject_motion: The player navigates tight rural curves at low speed before rapidly accelerating on a straight section.
annotation.environment_motion: A silver car remains parked on the roadside shoulder as the player passes.
annotation.camera_description: The camera is at eye-level in a stabilized first-person perspective, following the vehicle's motion as it corners and accelerates.

annotation.static_scene: A wide-open grassland with a narrow worn earth path, a prominent red torii gate in the distance, and a dark green forest tree line on the horizon.
annotation.subject_motion: The samurai character runs through tall golden grass toward a distant red torii gate.
annotation.environment_motion: Dense golden pampas grass sways in the wind surrounding the dirt path.
annotation.camera_description: The camera is in a stabilized third-person follow perspective at chest height, moving forward.

annotation.static_scene: A narrow dirt trail flanked by a tall weathered stone fortress wall on the left and a steep rocky cliff edge on the right, with misty mountains in the far distance under a golden sky.
annotation.subject_motion: The player walks steadily forward along a narrow cliffside path beside a fortress wall.
annotation.environment_motion: None; the scene is still except for the player's movement.
annotation.camera_description: A stabilized third-person follow camera at waist height, moving forward in a straight line.

annotation.static_scene: A semi-covered temple courtyard with paved tiles, featuring a rectangular sacred pool with lily pads, fluted stone columns with red and white bands, and a distant acropolis on the horizon.
annotation.subject_motion: The player walks forward from a standing position at the edge of a temple pool, passing seated individuals on stone benches.
annotation.environment_motion: A few NPCs are scattered around the courtyard, including a figure in brown robes resting by the pool edge.
annotation.camera_description: The camera follows the player from a stabilized third-person perspective at chest height, moving forward with a slight leftward drift.
